title: Smoky Barbecue Haloumi Burgers
subtitle: with Veggie Chips
description: Stop the flavour bus! Here's a brand-new recipe from our culinary dream team. Like all our dishes, it's got five easy cooking steps plus tips and hacks to make it your own. We think it’s a total winner – but you tell us! Leave a rating and comment through your account to let us know your thoughts.

steps.text: Roast veggie chips: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Cut the unpeeled potatoes into thin wedges (see Kitchen hack). Cut the carrots into thin chips. Put the potato and carrot on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 20 mins or until golden and tender.

Roast tomato: Meanwhile, cut the tomato into thin wedges and put on the remaining lined tray, drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil and toss to coat. Roast for 10 mins or until tender. Remove from the oven and scatter with 1 tsp barbecue seasoning.
Warm bread rolls: While the vegetables are roasting, cut the rolls in half. Put on the tray with the carrot and bake for 3-5 mins until warmed through.

Cook haloumi: Slice the haloumi. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Add the garlic and cook for a further 30 secs or until the garlic is lightly browned. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Combine the remaining barbecue seasoning and 2 tbs barbecue sauce in a bowl. Spread the roll bases and tops with the barbecue sauce, then layer with the haloumi and tomato. Serve with the veggie chips and enjoy!
Kitchen hack: Slice the potatoes into thin wedges so they roast in the same time as the carrot chips.
